qualification.details: Any Graduate degree with 0 to 2 Years of experience preferably in IP or academic project management.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Madras Junior Executive Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 14-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Madras to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Madras Junior Executive Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 14-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Madras to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Madras Junior Executive post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Junior Executive position at IIT Madras is 14 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Executive role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess any Graduate degree to be eligible for the Junior Executive position at IIT Madras.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for the IIT Madras Junior Executive recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Executive post?
faq.answer: The selected Junior Executive will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 18,000 to Rs. 30,000.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Executive post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Executive position at IIT Madras.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the IIT Madras Junior Executive recruitment is entirely online.

faq.question: Q7. What are the selection stages for the Junior Executive position?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Skill Test, Interview, and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is ICSR/PR/Advt.139/2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the Junior Executive position?
faq.answer: The Junior Executive position is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the links to the official notification and the online application form in the "Important Links" section of this article.
